introduction: Explore Dirk’nspire’s caves, town and competing clans; meet Balith and bring him the two kinds of intelligence he accepts.
orientation: The cave entrance connects to the Valinhav cave system. Successful arrival, finding a passage and opening or crossing it are separate actions.
Find Balith in the collapsed tunnel and ask maps or secrets. Map and secret are alternate keywords for the same conversation lead.

Balith accepts the sealed defense document for a scarab of Ghore. He also pays 2 platinum, 5 gold and 7 silver for the tattered silk-paper despite his disappointed reply. These are two independent requests.
The tattered paper is hidden inside guano at the cave dead end. Examine and search the open container, then GET its contents; a search or readable map alone does not acquire the paper.

The sealed document is declared inside a moneybox in Firb’s private chambers. Unlock attempts depend on current state, skill or magic, then opening and GET remain separate. Identical boxes can affect actual reset placement and stock.
The granite golem carries a bloodstone key for the pickproof main gate. Key recovery, unlocking, opening and crossing are separate; this route is not a remembered prerequisite for Balith’s returns.
Carry the requested item loose. A held, worn or nested item does not prepare a return. Supplied exact items also fit; current preparation changes after spending while recorded acceptance remains.
Balith’s worn scarab and a newly issued scarab reward have different acquisition histories. Merely possessing a scarab does not record the document return.

Firb’s Foe Hammer is also requested by Ragmor and Wikzor in Alatorin. Keeping or using it and spending it with the other four weapons are different choices. Those separate bounties do not complete a Balith request.
The homeless wemic can offer native instruction under current admission, and Flyrr runs a general store. Meeting either or carrying shop food does not complete Balith’s requests.

The damaged paper, slave pens, rival clans, temples and resident families suggest wider stories. Poisoning food, rescuing captives, learning or resolving clan conflict need explicit successful outcomes before awards.

stories.title: Bring Balith the sealed defense document
stories.summary: Carry the sealed document loose and offer it to Balith for a scarab of Ghore. This return can be completed independently of his other request.

steps.hint: Look for the moneybox in Firb’s private chambers. A closed locked box needs an admitted unlock attempt and opening before GET. Other identical boxes and global reset parent selection mean actual stock must be checked.

Offer the exact loose item to Balith when present for a scarab of Ghore. Supplied exact items also fit. Neither return requires the other, remembered conversation, a personal search or a source kill. Recorded acceptance survives spending; reward custody is a later outcome.
